name: HHS Robotics
summary: HHS Robotics is a Shanghai company developing embodied robots, commercial service robots and consumer robots. Its portfolio includes humanoid platforms for research and education, robot hands and commercial systems. The company presents Romeo R1 as a modular bipedal research platform and provides hardware and software interfaces for teaching, system integration and robot behavior development.
